roles.roleSummary: MOPS電纜與工程業務之外，官方能源鏈公告亦列集團太陽能案場；公司轉載的2026年報導確認600V至345kV電纜範圍。再生能源角色涵蓋集團發電及陸域輸配電，不能直接延伸為海底電纜訂單。本次TWSE最新回傳：2026年7月營收29.06億元，MoM-13.76%、YoY+11.53%，累計YoY+17.91%。公司整體營收不可直接歸因本題材。
products: 集團太陽能發電案場與電力管理業務
customers: 台電（再生能源併網對象，非MOPS揭露客戶）
沃旭能源Orsted（離岸風場應用對象，非MOPS揭露客戶）
哥本哈根基礎建設基金CIP（風場應用對象，非MOPS揭露客戶）
森崴能源(6806；綠能工程應用對象，非MOPS揭露客戶)
competitors: 華新（電力電纜比較對象）
華榮（電力電纜比較對象）
太平洋電線電纜（電力電纜比較對象）
risks: 引用的太陽能／儲能案場容量為歷史公告，不當成2026最新規模；無本批海纜訂單證據。
銅價、原料傳導及交貨時程影響電纜業務毛利與月營收。
2026年7月營收29.06億元，MoM-13.76%、YoY+11.53%，累計YoY+17.91%。公司整體口徑，不可直接歸因題材。

evidence.title: Taiwan’s semiconductor landscape is built, line by line. - Taya Group
evidence.claim: 來源摘錄（extracted live public page）：345 kV certification: A qualification that takes time to earn To enter the high-voltage power supply chain, suppliers must pass rigorous cable type tests. For 345 kV cables, testing under relevant standards includes high-voltage withstand tests, partial discharge tests, aging tests, and other evaluations to verify long-term stability under high-voltage conditions and temperature variations. Taya Electric Wire & Cable was Taiwan’s first local manufacturer to pass Taipower’s 345 kV cable type test. This “first” was not the result of a single test. It was the product of accumulated technical expertise and years of validation. From the selection of cable materials and structural design to manufacturing process control, every stage must meet the corresponding requirements. Taya became Taiwan’s first local manufacturer to pass Taipower’s 345 kV cable type test as early as 2008. Nearly two decades have passed since this qualification was obtained. Before the current wave of semiconductor fab construction arrived, Taya had already passed the first—and one of the most critical—thresholds for entering Taiwan’s highest-voltage transmission system. Taya’s product voltage range extends from 600 V to 345 kV, covering extra-high-voltage transmission outside the fab, 161 kV cables, internal power distribution, and specially designed cables for specific applications. This breadth connects the two worlds described above within a single product portfolio.
